title: Building Custom Zapier Integrations (Developer Platform)
summary: This day covers essential concepts for building AI engineering skills.
topics: Zapier Platform: UI builder vs CLI
Input/output fields, dynamic dropdowns, and dedup
practical_task_reference: Using the Zapier Platform CLI, scaffold a custom integration for a public API: implement API-key authentication, one polling trigger with deduplication, and one create action with input/output fields, then test it locally.
mini_project_reference: Build and test a custom Zapier integration for an API of your choice with OAuth2 authentication (auth flow + token refresh), at least one trigger, one action, one search, dynamic dropdowns, and a test suite.
assignment_reference: Explain the difference between a polling trigger and a REST-hook trigger in a Zapier integration, and describe why deduplication and versioning matter for integration quality.
